description: This file provides functions for managing 'snippets' in a project, including fetching, creating, updating, deleting, and toggling public visibility. It interfaces with a backend database via Supabase client and includes various utility functions to perform CRUD operations and filtering of snippet data.

methods.name: getSnippets({ search = "", tag = "", limit = 20, offset = 0 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of snippets from the database with optional search filters for content or tags, supports pagination.

methods.name: getSnippetById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a single snippet by its unique identifier.

methods.name: createSnippet(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new snippet entry in the database with provided payload data.

methods.name: updateSnippet(id, patch)
methods.description: Updates an existing snippet identified by id with provided patch data.

methods.name: deleteSnippet(id)
methods.description: Deletes the snippet with the specified id from the database.

methods.name: togglePublic(id, isPublic)
methods.description: Toggles the public visibility status of a snippet.

ctags.name: getSnippets
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getSnippets({ search = "", tag = "", limit = 20, offset = 0 } = {}) {$/
